The finding claims that when APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED is true, the sync endpoint returns only access_token and expiry (as documented in parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts minimumTokenResponseSchema), but the code stores the entire responseBody without merging with existing credentials. Unlike office365calendar which uses parseRefreshTokenResponse to handle this, office365video does not use parseRefreshTokenResponse - it just stores responseBody directly. This means refresh_token would be lost when the sync endpoint is used, breaking future refreshes.
